# Decisions

Written by `dotnet cleanarch docs-index` from the frontmatter of each page:
edit the pages, then run it again.

- [0001. Options remove parts and refuse combinations](0001-options-remove-parts-and-refuse-combinations.md) - Accepted. Why an option removes what it leaves out of a generated project rather than disabling it, and refuses the combinations that cannot hold.
- [0002. Nothing about the template reaches a project](0002-nothing-about-the-template-reaches-a-project.md) - Superseded. Why nothing about the template but its provenance reached a project, before a project also kept the tool it pins.
- [0003. Framework apps come from their official CLIs](0003-framework-apps-come-from-official-clis.md) - Superseded. Why the template kept no framework code and each web app came from its framework's official CLI, until starters replaced it.
- [0004. The launcher reads the templates' manifests](0004-the-launcher-reads-the-templates-manifests.md) - Superseded. Why the launcher asked its questions from the templates' own manifests, until the project's tool read them too.
- [0005. A project carries one database provider](0005-a-project-carries-one-database-provider.md) - Accepted. Why a generated project holds one database provider, chosen at generation, and no other provider's code.
- [0006. develop integrates, main holds the releases](0006-develop-integrates-main-holds-the-releases.md) - Superseded. Why develop integrated every change, its branches kept, and main held the releases.
- [0007. GitHub Packages mirrors nuget.org](0007-github-packages-mirrors-nuget-org.md) - Accepted. Why nuget.org is the template's feed and GitHub Packages only mirrors it.
- [0008. A web app comes from a starter](0008-a-web-app-comes-from-a-starter.md) - Superseded. Why a web app came from a starter, one shared wiring and a folder per framework, before server rendering joined it.
- [0009. A .NET project comes from a starter](0009-a-dotnet-project-comes-from-a-starter.md) - Accepted. Why a .NET project a starter adds comes from a template package its descriptor names, as a web app comes from pnpm.
- [0010. A pull request runs the legs its change can affect](0010-a-pull-request-runs-the-legs-its-change-can-affect.md) - Accepted. Why a pull request runs only the acceptance legs its changed paths can affect, and how a selector chooses them.
- [0011. A starter may render on the server](0011-a-starter-may-render-on-the-server.md) - Superseded. Why rendering on the server was an option of its own beside the web framework, until one decision held both.
- [0012. Where the jobs run is an option](0012-where-the-jobs-run-is-an-option.md) - Superseded. Why where the jobs run was an option of its own, until the worker became a presentation project.
- [0013. A starter the generator cannot add to is written whole](0013-a-starter-the-generator-cannot-add-to-is-written-whole.md) - Accepted. Why a starter whose framework generator cannot be added to holds the whole project, written by the template.
- [0014. A Windows-only shape is proved on a Windows runner](0014-a-windows-only-shape-is-proved-on-a-windows-runner.md) - Accepted. Why a generated shape that builds only on Windows is proved by an acceptance leg on a Windows runner.
- [0015. An MCP server is a presentation project, written whole](0015-an-mcp-server-is-a-presentation-project-written-whole.md) - Superseded. Why the MCP server was a presentation project written whole, under the rule a later decision restated.
- [0016. The launcher draws only glyphs every console font carries](0016-the-launcher-draws-only-glyphs-every-console-font-carries.md) - Accepted. Why the launcher draws, above Latin-1, only the glyphs every console font carries.
- [0017. A project runs its tasks from a pinned .NET tool](0017-a-project-runs-its-tasks-from-a-pinned-dotnet-tool.md) - Accepted. Why a project runs its tasks from a .NET tool pinned at the template's version, while another tool only creates projects.
- [0018. A project keeps its provenance and its tool from the template](0018-a-project-keeps-its-provenance-and-its-tool-from-the-template.md) - Accepted. Why a project keeps a record of the template that generated it and the tool it pins, while every other page stays the project's own.
- [0019. The launcher creates, and the project's tool adds](0019-the-launcher-creates-and-the-project-tool-adds.md) - Accepted. Why the launcher only creates a project, and the project's own tool adds every part afterwards.
- [0020. A project is the presentation projects it holds](0020-a-project-is-the-presentation-projects-it-holds.md) - Accepted. Why one multi-valued option names every host a project holds, the API among them.
- [0021. A project reads a newer version by generating both](0021-a-project-reads-a-newer-version-by-generating-both.md) - Accepted. Why a project reads what a newer template version changes by generating both versions and comparing three ways.
- [0022. A WPF app is one Windows project, tested on Windows](0022-a-wpf-app-is-one-windows-project-tested-on-windows.md) - Accepted. Why the WPF app is one Windows project, laid out as the Avalonia app, with its tests run on Windows.
- [0023. A web app comes from a starter, static or server-rendered](0023-a-web-app-comes-from-a-starter-static-or-server-rendered.md) - Accepted. Why a web app comes from a starter, one shared wiring and a folder per framework, static or rendered on the server.
- [0024. The worker takes the jobs out of the API](0024-the-worker-takes-the-jobs-out-of-the-api.md) - Accepted. Why the worker is a presentation project that takes the periodic jobs out of the API.
- [0025. An MCP server is a presentation project, written whole](0025-an-mcp-server-is-a-presentation-project-written-whole.md) - Accepted. Why the MCP server is a value of the presentation option, written whole by the template under the symbols every presentation project shares.
- [0026. The launcher and the project's tool read the templates' manifests](0026-the-launcher-and-the-project-tool-read-the-templates-manifests.md) - Accepted. Why the launcher and the project's tool both ask their questions from the templates' own manifests.
- [0027. develop integrates, main holds the releases](0027-develop-integrates-main-holds-the-releases.md) - Accepted. Why develop integrates every change through branches deleted once merged, and main holds the releases.
